name: Nightdesk
description: A graphite operations dashboard system for teams that live inside their numbers: dense tables, gantt timelines, and KPI panels on a near-black shell, with color held back for gain, loss, and progress.
concept: Nightdesk is the late-shift control desk. A matte charcoal canvas holds a single inset near-black shell, and inside it every panel is a flat graphite slab separated by 1px hairlines instead of shadows. Color is rationed like a signal: green only for gain, red only for loss, cobalt only for progress. Idle time is drawn, not labeled, as a fine diagonal hatch over weekends and empty chart areas, so the eye reads workload density at a glance. Figures are set in a monospace with tabular rhythm so columns of money and dates align like a ledger.

palette.name: Canvas
palette.role: Page background around the app shell

palette.name: Shell
palette.role: App frame, sidebar, and main work area

palette.name: Raised
palette.role: Buttons, gantt bars, active nav rows, tooltips

palette.name: Hairline
palette.role: Borders, dividers, table rules, hatch strokes

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text and figures; muted text uses #8A8A8A

palette.name: Gain
palette.role: Positive deltas, cashflow lines, healthy status bars

palette.name: Loss
palette.role: Negative deltas, burn lines, at-risk status bars

fonts.name: Fira Sans
fonts.usage: Interface text, navigation, headings, table content

fonts.name: Sometype Mono
fonts.usage: KPI figures, currency, dates, counts, and percentages

iconPack.name: Lucide
iconPack.usage: 1.5px outline icons at 16px for navigation, panel headers, table metadata, and toolbar actions.
